name: Labindia Instruments Pvt. Ltd.
india_angle: Labindia Instruments manufactures lab instruments under the 'Make in India' initiative, supporting diverse applications across life sciences, pharma, and industrial research.
summary: Labindia Instruments Pvt. Their offerings support innovation in material science and R&D sectors, with a focus on the Indian market.
